strings.name: Marion Cotillard
strings.summary: Cotillard moved from French drama training and genre films into international cinema, winning an Oscar as Piaf in La Vie en Rose. Across French and English work, Rust and Bone, Two Days, One Night and Annette show complex characterization. Documentary production and climate advocacy extend her cultural activity beyond acting.
